text:
alex: FYI bringing up orpheusx-lite (3.8B variant) for int4 dedicated runs — after conversion+quant we see a consistent summarization quality drop for long context (8k+). small repro attached below.

maya: can you paste the exact conversion command and the eval metric?

alex: conversion: `python tools/convert.py --src orpheusx --dst redwood --int4 --rotary-mode=auto`
metrics: eval-suite rouge-l on our long-docs set dropped from 42.9 -> 36.3, perplexity up ~6%. latency stable.

suraj: did we change rotary/dtype handling anywhere? auto rotary mode sometimes picks headwise scaling and we've seen head-count mismatches before.

alex: build used runtime v2.14.3; converter inferred head_dim=64 from model header but the original had per-head hetero mappings (adapter merged). converter flattened them -> possible head-to-head misalign.

felix: i've seen "head folding" issues when merging checkpoints from llama-style to gemma/mistral forks. If rotary freqs are per-head and mapping is off that could cause phase drift and downstream quality regressions.
jordan: any quick smoke eval comparing logits before quant vs after quant on same seed? that helps isolate quant noise vs mapping bug.

alex: ran tokenwise logit-diff: top1 mismatch increases over sequence position, almost zero at first 32 tokens then ramps after 2k tokens. snippet:```python
# quick compare
for i in range(len(seq)):
  diff = np.abs(logits_fp32[i] - logits_int4[i]).mean()
  print(i, diff)
```

maya: interesting — ramp suggests k-v cache or rotary phase accumulation issue rather than static quant noise (which would be immediate and uniform).

suraj: can you dump a headwise rotary-phase matrix for a short example and compare between pre-conversion and post-conversion? also check token-id remapping: some vocab merges shadow special sentinels and change offsets which can shift positions for long prefix caching.

alex: will do. grabbing headwise phase and kv snapshots now.

infra-bot: scheduled job redwood-eval/1788002468-run-1 queued on dedicated-gpu-pool (tag: orpheusx-int4-smoke). ETA 8m.

triage-bot: created issue RED-ML-1127 "orpheusx-lite int4 longctx rouge regression" and assigned to eng-ml. Labels: bug, prioritise-sanity.

felix: quick hypothesis list: 1) rotary head index remap due to hetero-heads flattened 2) kvcache token offset introduced by vocab merge 3) int4 scaling calibration per-head incorrectly broadcast 4) pack/unpack endianness with kv cache backend.
jordan: to triage: (A) compare logits pre/post at head-level (B) run eval with `--rotary-mode=explicit` forcing converter not to remap (C) run calibration with per-head scales (D) check vocab offset table `tools/vocab-inspect.py --model orpheusx`.

alex: quick results: forcing `--rotary-mode=explicit` recovered ~3.5 rouge points (36.3 -> 39.8). per-head calibration gave small uplift (~0.7). vocab-inspect shows 2 sentinel tokens shifted by +128 after our merge step.

maya: so likely two contributors: sentinel shift (affects long prefix alignment) + implicit head remap. both explain ramping error pattern.

suraj: plan: 1) revert converter to preserve original head-index mapping unless adapter merging detected 2) add a vocab-shadow check that fails conversions when sentinel collisions >0 3) add an eval smoke (longctx-rouge) to CI for int4 on new models.

alex: i'll open a converter PR with a toggle `--preserve-headmap` + unit tests and add vocab-shadow guard.

infra-bot: queued pipeline run for branch alex/orpheusx-headmap-fix (CI: unit, smoke-eval).

felix: once PR lands, let's rerun on the dedicated pool and check long-doc suite and also measure token-level logit-diff slope. will also test with gemma/qwen family cross-checks — same bugpattern historically.

alex: thanks team. I'll drop the PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
